newsitem.title: UK: Bodycote down after press talk on share sale.
newsitem.headline: Bodycote down after press talk on share sale.

text.p: Shares in British engineering services group Bodycote International Plc fell back on Monday after newspaper comment on recent share sales by directors, analysts said.
Bodycote shares were down 27.5 pence, or 3.68 percent, to 720p by 0800 GMT in volume of 35,000 while the FTSE-100 index was 6.1 points, or 0.14 percent, lower at 4,363.6.
The Sunday Times newpaper said directors' share dealings "suggest some cause for concern".
The paper said while Bodycote's chief executive John Chesworth had bought more shares than he had sold in recent months, chairman Joe Dwek had been a big seller.
Dwek sold 455,997 ordinary shares at 745p per share last week, bringing his holding to 3,376,200 shares, or 4.22 percent of the company.
